name: Execution Channel Evidence Contract
principles: execution-channel availability is separate from listing state and market tradability
an instrument is AVAILABLE only with explicit instrument-level PIT evidence from a registered execution channel
absence of evidence is UNKNOWN and never AVAILABLE or UNAVAILABLE
price availability, scanner presence, symbol suffixes and universe membership are not execution-channel evidence
no credentials, account identifiers or personal authentication material may be stored in QM evidence
multiple channels may coexist; one PIT-verified AVAILABLE channel is sufficient for the execution-channel dimension
restrictions and explicit unavailability must remain representable
